anti_overlap: Temporal dynamics across modules, not schema correctness (fd-sqlalchemy) or async lifecycle (fd-asyncio)
decision_lens: Every system has fast processes (yeasts, immediate extraction) and slow processes (terroir development, profile evolution) — the interaction between timescales determines quality
distance_rationale: Fermentation manages multi-timescale processes (hours to decades) in a single vessel — completely different domain from software but structurally identical temporal coupling
expected_isomorphisms: Starter culture stability maps to core profile stability; batch vs continuous fermentation maps to event-driven vs periodic profile regen; terroir development maps to long-term preference drift
focus: Temporal layering of preference extraction and profile evolution — how fast and slow processes coexist
name: fd-fermentation-temporal-layering
persona: Master fermentation scientist who manages microbial cultures across timescales from hours to decades
review_areas: Fast extraction (3-second burst) feeding slow profile evolution (30-day TTL): is the coupling appropriate?
Momentum field on PreferenceEntity: does it capture trend direction or just recency?
EMA scoring window implicit in delta values: does it match the actual feedback timescale?
Session retention (90 days) vs entity retention (30-day expired hard-delete): gap allows orphaned references
Profile regeneration triggered by dirty flag: is it batch (periodic) or event-driven (every entity change)?
Contradiction tracking (source_contradicts): does it preserve the temporal arc of changing mind?

severity_examples.condition: User discusses a topic once, 5 entities extracted, profile narrative dominated by single conversation
severity_examples.scenario: Fast extraction overwhelms slow profile with transient preferences

severity_examples.condition: source_contradicts UUID points to entity hard-deleted after 30-day TTL
severity_examples.scenario: Contradiction link to expired entity leaves dangling reference

success_hints: Focus on temporal coupling between extraction.py, lens_evolution.py, profile_gen.py, and retention.py
task_context: Signal-first refactor must preserve temporal layering — fast subscribers must not overwhelm slow ones
